_comment: Ground-truth answer key for the fixture set. Keyed by asset file. Each entry lists the violations deliberately planted in that mock — this is the eval key for the extractor/checker/judge agents. Compliant fixtures have empty arrays. rule_area values are informal here (the rulebook agent owns canonical rule_ids); match on rule_area + claim_text. claim_text is STRICTLY literal: it appears verbatim in the entity-decoded, tag-stripped, comment-stripped, whitespace-collapsed text of the mock — or is null for absence/layout findings, with location_note carrying the context. Enforced by validate_fixtures.py. expected_claim_type uses the legal-entity ClaimType enum (rulebook v2026.08.3 / claim_types_legal_map.json), null for absence-type findings; expected_rule_ids are canonical rulebook v2026.08.3 rule_ids expected to fire. Claim-anchored findings may carry expected_normalized_fields (OPTIONAL since the payload trim; only surviving payload fields appear): {field: value} for value grading, field names exactly per claim_types_legal_map.json normalized_fields (optional-field '?' suffix stripped); only mock-derivable values included; null used where the map defines null semantics (e.g. fixed_period_stated null = unbounded claim).

expected_findings.description: 'Pre-approved' designation used on marketplace offer cells PL-36-A/PL-60-A whose badge_designation_allowed is 'prequalified' and is_firm_offer is FALSE — no FCRA firm offer backs this claim (FTC v. Credit Karma fact pattern).

expected_findings.claim_text: Guaranteed approval — regardless of credit history
expected_findings.location_note: green emphasis line below the APR line
expected_findings.description: Guaranteed-approval claim is deceptive where any underwriting exists (FTC Act §5 / UDAAP; Reg N 1014.3(q) analog for likelihood-of-approval misrepresentation).

expected_findings.location_note: approval-not-guaranteed qualifier absent from fine print (present in approved v7 template)
expected_findings.description: The approval-not-guaranteed qualifier present in the approved v7 fine print is absent, compounding the approval misrepresentation. (judge-covered pending the qualifier-rule gap fix — no deterministic rule requires the qualifier for 'pre-approved'-only creative)

mock_cc_card_net_impression.html._review_note: The only mock in the set whose sole issue is a judgment call: every deterministic Reg Z defect of the earlier v5 draft was fixed in the creative ('intro' now adjacent to the promotional rate; the end-of-promo period and post-promotional APR moved up next to the first listing at normal type size), leaving one gray-area net-impression question for the judge. CC-TRIG-001 was dropped from the row below because the companion open-end disclosures (post-intro APR range, variable-rate statement, balance-transfer fee) are now present on the creative and in the manifest, so the deterministic trigger rule is satisfied.

expected_findings.claim_text: No annual fee. No interest. No brainer.
expected_findings.description: 'No annual fee'/'No interest' framing omits the 3% balance-transfer fee and the fact that interest is deferred rather than absent; the overall net impression of a cost-free card is a UDAAP judgment call even though every number on the creative is individually accurate.

mock_nw_cc_forever_bt.html._withdrawn_note: A 'promo_terms_vs_offer_matrix' finding expecting CC-TRUTH-001 was planted here and has been WITHDRAWN: the rule cannot fire on this creative. CC-TRUTH-001 is a composite_all of ground_truth_consistency sub-checks, i.e. purely NUMERIC reconciliation of claim payload against the referenced offer cell, and every number this creative states is TRUE of CC-PLAT — 0% intro APR (intro_apr_pct 0.00), '15 billing cycles' (intro_period_months 15), 19.24%–29.24% post-promo (apr_min/apr_max), $0 annual fee (annual_fee 0), and a review date inside effective_start..effective_end. The planted deception is qualitative: 'forever' (a duration no number in the creative contradicts — the correct 15-cycle term is stated one line below) and the purchases-only restriction, which lives only in the offer matrix's free-text `notes` column that no deterministic primitive reads. Absence of a claim field cannot fire the rule either: ground_truth_consistency returns early on 'nothing claimed -> nothing to reconcile'. 'forever' also appears in no lexicon or pattern in rulebook/data/, and no llm_judged credit_card rule covers promo duration/scope (CC-JUDGE-001 is rewards, XP-COMP-003 superlatives, XP-ODDS-005 approval odds, XP-TEST-006 testimonials), so the violation is unreachable in rulebook v2026.08.4 rather than merely mis-attributed. The mock's other two planted violations (CC-INTRO-001, XP-UDAAP-001-credit_card) fire correctly and are unchanged.

expected_findings.location_note: headline; the words 'intro' and 'introductory' appear nowhere in the creative
expected_findings.description: Promotional rate stated without the term 'intro'/'introductory' in immediate proximity to its listing (Reg Z 1026.16(g)(3)). The post-promo sentence directly below satisfies 1026.16(g)(4) proximity, so CC-INTRO-002 is deliberately NOT planted here — the adjacency failure is isolated.

expected_findings.claim_text: Transfer your balance risk-free — there is nothing to lose.
expected_findings.location_note: green emphasis line below the post-promotional APR sentence
expected_findings.description: 'risk-free' is a per-se prohibited phrase in the UDAAP lexicon (FTC Act §5 / 12 U.S.C. 5531). A transfer on this card carries a 3% balance-transfer fee and reverts to a 19.24%-29.24% variable APR, so the representation is false as well as prohibited.

expected_findings.claim_text: Pre-approved government-backed loans — rates locked forever
expected_findings.location_note: headline; the manifest badge_text also reads 'Pre-approved' and the CTA reads 'Claim my pre-approval'
expected_findings.description: Reg N 12 CFR 1014.3(q): mortgage prequal creative may never use 'pre-approved' or other approval-certainty language regardless of offer flags — MTG-30F and MTG-ARM both allow only the 'prequalified' designation and neither is a firm offer.

expected_findings.claim_text: Ask about our government-backed programs, including FHA and VA loan options, on a $400,000 loan amount.
expected_findings.location_note: body line under the fixed-rate claim
expected_findings.description: Reg N 12 CFR 1014.3(n): government-program vocabulary ('government-backed', FHA, VA loan) implies agency provision, endorsement or affiliation. Neither referenced cell is a verified government-program loan (government_program_verified is false/unresolved for MTG-30F and MTG-ARM).

expected_findings.claim_text: Your 5/6 ARM rate is fixed for the life of the loan.
expected_findings.location_note: orange emphasis line directly under the headline; reinforced by the headline's 'rates locked forever'
expected_findings.description: MTG-ARM is apr_type variable and its matrix notes explicitly forbid describing it as 'fixed' (Reg N 1014.3; Reg Z 1026.24(i)(1)) — the creative states the opposite in terms.

seed_screenshot_pl_card_verified.html._verification_note: Verification-mode fixture with NO drift: the seed-account capture reproduces the approved baseline (SUB-2026-0142) exactly — the 8.99% matrix floor and the full qualifier fine print are both intact, and the manifest carries the same disclosure set as the baseline row. A verified-consistent production capture is the positive half of the fidelity demo: the mode still runs, the baseline join key is still populated, and the correct answer is an empty finding list.
